baseline_best.scope: Post-hoc grouping proxies only; no physical-volume or millimetre interpretation, and no replacement of the original pixel-pooled metric.

improved_best.scope: Post-hoc grouping proxies only; no physical-volume or millimetre interpretation, and no replacement of the original pixel-pooled metric.

improved_last.scope: Post-hoc grouping proxies only; no physical-volume or millimetre interpretation, and no replacement of the original pixel-pooled metric.

unavailable_weight_note: Only Improved best3 and last20 exist. Epoch17 max-ID5 is historical aggregate only and is not replayed.

selection_rules.A_missed_region: Improved best3: lowest pooled-ID5-Dice reference-positive case/week group; within it R>=20 and FN>0, maximize FN/R then FN, then numeric case/week/slice and basename.
selection_rules.B_empty_reference_fp: Improved best3: R=0 and FP>0, maximize FP then numeric metadata. Report FP/Nvalid, not an organ-positive Dice estimate.
selection_rules.C_few_reference_pixels: Improved best3: 0<R<20 and FN>0, maximize FN/R then FN, then numeric metadata. Twenty pixels is a diagnostic bin, not a clinical threshold.
selection_rules.D_late_improvement: R>=20, maximize positive Dice(last20)-Dice(best3), then numeric metadata.
selection_rules.E_late_regression: R>=20, minimize negative Dice(last20)-Dice(best3), then numeric metadata.

duplicate_policy: A through E in order; exclude previously selected slice; no fallback if a category has no candidate.
example_scope: Failure-mode illustrations chosen post hoc, not a random sample or failure-frequency estimate; all metrics use original full pixels.

fixed_set_analysis.interpretation: Same pixel sets defined jointly by best3/last20 and reference. p_true is the probability assigned to the true class, not maximum-softmax confidence. No calibration error metric is measured.

failure_cases.selection_rule: Improved best3: lowest pooled-ID5-Dice reference-positive case/week group; within it R>=20 and FN>0, maximize FN/R then FN, then numeric case/week/slice and basename.

roi_bounds_pixels.basis: union of reference ID5 and all three predictions, clipped to image; empty union uses full image

failure_cases.selection_rule: Improved best3: R=0 and FP>0, maximize FP then numeric metadata. Report FP/Nvalid, not an organ-positive Dice estimate.

ce_definition: Per valid pixel -log p(true class); class contribution is NLL_sum_c / all valid pixels, not class-mean CE or a sum of six class errors per pixel.
label_mapping_boundary: ID5 is interpreted as prostate only under the previously accepted unverified derivative-ID-preservation assumption.
geometry_boundary: Case/week are grouping proxies, affines/physical units are not independently validated here; no millimetre or clinical-size claims.
claim_boundary: Post-hoc validation diagnosis. No original formal selection/result was replaced, no epoch17 weights were reconstructed, and no test or new training occurred.
diagnostic_revision_note: The first draft field named all predicted-ID5 true-class counts as FP sources and included the TP cell. The final runner separates that column from FP sources (true-ID5 entry zero), asserts both totals, and was rerun fully into a fresh v2 directory. Earlier draft files are retained under ignored outputs with a superseded marker. Formal results/checkpoints were never edited.

baseline_best.scope: At least one pixel; descriptive counts on these validation slices, not clinical event rates.

improved_best.scope: At least one pixel; descriptive counts on these validation slices, not clinical event rates.

improved_last.scope: At least one pixel; descriptive counts on these validation slices, not clinical event rates.

recommendation_not_applied.status: diagnostic recommendation only; no formal reselection or training performed
recommendation_not_applied.primary_selection_if_id5_dice_is_the_goa: For a future shared protocol, maximize the predeclared validation ID5 Dice; exact ties lower validation CE then earliest epoch.
recommendation_not_applied.aggregation: Predeclare pixel-pooled or case-balanced based on the intended goal. Keep both reports separate. The current formal primary remains pixel-pooled.
recommendation_not_applied.checkpoint_retention: Save both CE-best and ID5-best plus last under clearly different names in a future protocol. Epoch17 weights are currently unavailable.
recommendation_not_applied.training_loss: Changing the selection criterion and changing CE training loss are separate design decisions; this diagnosis does not change the training objective.
recommendation_not_applied.scope: Use validation only for future protocol design; establish final test boundary separately. User acceptance of a label assumption is not independent mapping proof.

visual_review.roi_rule: Full image retained; union of reference/predicted ID5 plus eight-pixel margin is display-only. All counts/Dice use the full original image.
visual_review.interpretation_boundary: Error types relative to supplied reference only. No clinical size, millimetre, anatomy-correction or model-module causality claim.
